claim_ceiling: Mathematical signal fixture only. Not human physiology, sensor calibration, or public-person data.

notes: The 1200 s duration contains an integer number of cycles for each declared component at the native sampling rate.
All amplitudes, phases, and frequencies are mathematical fixture values, not human or sensor parameters.

anti_aliasing.production_filter_requirement: Every implemented filter must pin family, order/taps, cutoff convention, phase mode, boundary handling, group delay and implementation version.

expected_information_retention.definition: sum of ideal in-band power in the task-critical component set below the post-decimation Nyquist frequency divided by total task-critical component power

derivation.after_0_08_hz_sampling: Nyquist 0.04 Hz < 0.05 Hz; no task-band component retained

evaluation_rules: Do not treat embedding invariance as equivalent to forecast or classification invariance.
Keep physical context duration and forecast horizon constant across rate conditions.
Separate information-preserving from information-destroying rate conditions.
Compare model degradation to ideal task-band information retention; do not penalise irrecoverable information loss as model error.
For the fixed-token lane, decimate with anti-aliasing and interpolate back to the same token length.
For event-native irregular-time experiments, retain true event timestamps and do not interpolate unless that resampling policy is the named baseline.
